name: Salesforce Service Cloud (Contact Center)
description: Primary contact center platform of record. Real-time and historical voice, chat, email, and social interaction data across brands — queue metrics, agent performance, routing decisions, sentiment scores.

name: Billing and Subscriptions
description: Subscription, renewal, auto-renewal, dunning, invoice, refund, and chargeback records across all brands. Drives renewal-spike and churn prediction.

name: Domain Registrar and Registry
description: Domain status, registration, renewal, transfer, expiration, WHOIS, and DNS records across the brand portfolio.

name: Hosting Control Panel and Provisioning
description: Account provisioning, suspension and reactivation status, resource usage, control-panel state, uptime, and migration status.

name: Customer 360 / CRM
description: Customer profiles, product holdings, tenure, lifetime value, churn score, and interaction history across all brands. Links care activity to the customer lifecycle.

name: Marketing Cloud / Campaigns
description: Campaign schedules, renewal and price-increase notices, promotions, and email deployments. Critical for predicting volume spikes from outbound activity.

name: IT and Infrastructure Monitoring
description: Outage records, cloud-region and data-center health, provisioning incidents, and change management. Correlates infrastructure events with contact volume and sentiment.

name: Workforce Management + Snowflake
description: Agent schedules, adherence, PTO, force-to-load, overtime, and BPO capacity, with a 3-year cross-brand analytics history in Snowflake for trend and churn modeling.
